name: Primal banana
summary:
This is a fast-paced VR movement game where players climb, run, and jump using their hands. Explore multiple maps, practice your movement skills, and play with friends in online rooms. The game focuses on pure physical locomotion with no stick movement, letting players rely on their arms to move around the environment.
